title: DO NOT USE WITH HOT LIQUID
text: DO NOT USE WITH HOT LIQUID. Loved the size and shape but they are NOT Mason jars. They are simply decorative. I tried to use for refrigerator pickles. Hot liquid was poured in on top of pickles and they cracked and shattered.
